title: Hoxb4 upregulation by Xuan Bi Tong Yu Fang confers cardioprotection via repression of the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury.
authors: Li, Peng-Fei; Xu, Han-Ying; Liu, Tian-Ying; Li, Xiao-Hui; Li, Hong-Yu; Cheng, Guang-Yu; Liu, Ai-Dong; Li, Shuang-di
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过上调Hoxb4抑制Wnt通路保护心肌缺血再灌注损伤，仅含分子对接初步涉及蛋白-小分子互作，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury (MIRI) remains a significant challenge in treating cardiovascular diseases, contributing to substantial myocardial damage and a poor prognosis. Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) offers promising alternatives, with Xuan Bi Tong Yu Fang (XBTYF) being a classical formula known for its protective effects. However, the therapeutic mechanisms of XBTYF in MIRI have not been fully explored. MATERIALS AND METHODS: MIRI was induced in 36 Wistar rats, which were randomly assigned to sham, model, XBTYF (high, medium, low dose), and positive control (Qishen Yiqi Droplet) groups (n = 6). Serum levels of CK, AST, and cTnI were measured, and myocardial injury was examined by TTC, HE, and Masson staining. Bulk RNA-seq was performed to analyze gene expression profiles. The chemical composition of XBTYF was characterized by UPLC-MS/MS, followed by molecular docking to assess interactions between key compounds and Hoxb4. In vitro, H9C2 cardiomyocytes were subjected to oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R) and treated with XBTYF. The role of Hoxb4 in regulating the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway was examined through gain- and loss-of-function approaches, together with the Wnt inhibitor IWR-1. Cell viability, proliferation, apoptosis, and the expression of apoptosis-related proteins and Wnt/beta-catenin pathway components were assessed. RESULTS: XBTYF treatment significantly reduced myocardial enzyme levels and myocardial infarction area in the MIRI rats. Histological analysis showed improved myocardial tissue structure and reduced fibrosis. Bulk RNA-seq analysis identified Hoxb4 as a key gene restored by XBTYF and revealed a significant suppressive effect of XBTYF on the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway. Chemical analysis identified multiple bioactive compounds in XBTYF, and molecular docking further revealed that ginsenoside Rg3, a primary component, exhibited a strong binding affinity with the Hoxb4 protein. In vitro studies confirmed that XBTYF upregulated Hoxb4, promoting cell proliferation and inhibiting apoptosis under OGD/R condition. Western blot analysis validated that XBTYF inhibited Wnt/beta-catenin signaling, which was associated with reduced apoptosis and improved myocardial protection. CONCLUSION: XBTYF alleviates MIRI by upregulating Hoxb4 and subsequent inhibition of the Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway, leading to reduced cardiomyocyte apoptosis and providing cardio protection. Its effects may be linked to direct interactions between bioactive constituents, such as ginsenoside Rg3, and Hoxb4. Collectively, these findings provide mechanistic and experimental evidence supporting XBTYF as a potential adjunctive therapeutic strategy for ischemia-reperfusion-related myocardial injury and establish a molecular basis for its further translational investigation and clinical application.
abstract_zh: 背景：心肌缺血再灌注损伤（MIRI）仍是心血管疾病治疗中的重大挑战，可导致显著心肌损伤及不良预后。中医药提供了有前景的替代方案，其中宣痹通瘀方（XBTYF）作为经典方剂，以其保护作用而著称。然而，XBTYF在MIRI中的治疗机制尚未被充分探索。材料与方法：在36只Wistar大鼠中诱导MIRI，随机分为假手术组、模型组、XBTYF（高、中、低剂量）组及阳性对照组（芪参益气滴丸）（每组n = 6）。检测血清中CK、AST和cTnI水平，并通过TTC、HE和Masson染色检查心肌损伤。采用批量RNA测序（Bulk RNA-seq）分析基因表达谱。通过UPLC-MS/MS表征XBTYF的化学成分，随后进行分子对接以评估关键化合物与Hoxb4之间的相互作用。在体外，对H9C2心肌细胞进行氧糖剥夺/复氧（OGD/R）处理，并给予XBTYF干预。通过功能获得和功能丧失方法，结合Wnt抑制剂IWR-1，检测Hoxb4在调控Wnt/β-catenin通路中的作用。评估细胞活力、增殖、凋亡，以及凋亡相关蛋白和Wnt/β-catenin通路组分的表达。结果：XBTYF治疗显著降低了MIRI大鼠的心肌酶水平和心肌梗死面积。组织学分析显示心肌组织结构改善，纤维化减少。批量RNA测序分析将Hoxb4鉴定为XBTYF恢复的关键基因，并揭示XBTYF对Wnt/β-catenin信号通路具有显著抑制作用。化学分析鉴定出XBTYF中的多种生物活性化合物，分子对接进一步揭示其主要成分人参皂苷Rg3与Hoxb4蛋白表现出强结合亲和力。体外研究证实，XBTYF上调Hoxb4，在OGD/R条件下促进细胞增殖并抑制凋亡。Western blot分析验证了XBTYF抑制Wnt/β-catenin信号传导，这与凋亡减少和心肌保护改善相关。结论：XBTYF通过上调Hoxb4并随后抑制Wnt/β-catenin信号通路来缓解MIRI，从而减少心肌细胞凋亡并提供心脏保护。其效应可能与生物活性成分（如人参皂苷Rg3）与Hoxb4的直接相互作用有关。总体而言，这些发现为支持XBTYF作为缺血再灌注相关心肌损伤的潜在辅助治疗策略提供了机制和实验证据，并为其进一步转化研究和临床应用奠定了分子基础。
